findings.claim: Focused verification is incomplete because the recorded evidence does not include the required focused T0/T1, foreign-tenant publication sabotage-and-restore, artifact-refiner, or adversarial review runs.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 requires: "Run focused T0/T1 plus foreign-tenant publication sabotage-and-restore, artifact-refiner, and adversarial review." The evidence file records only `NODE_OPTIONS='--max_old_space_size=4096 --no-experimental-webstorage' npm test -- --run <16 Web-02 files>` plus TypeScript/lint.
findings.suggested_fix: Run and record the missing T0/T1, foreign-tenant sabotage-and-restore, artifact-refiner, and adversarial review commands with observed outputs.

findings.claim: Completion evidence is insufficient because it records a summarized placeholder command and omits the required actual command outputs and documentation/spec delta confirmation.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.1 requires: "Record actual commands and observed outputs, confirm real mounted callers at this change boundary, update documentation/spec deltas, and mark only satisfied work complete." The evidence says `npm test -- --run <16 Web-02 files>` and "passed 16/16 files and 57/57 tests" without listing the actual 16 files, command output, mounted caller confirmation details, or documentation/spec deltas.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the summarized evidence with exact commands, full observed outputs or stable excerpts, mounted caller confirmation, and explicit documentation/spec delta status.

findings.claim: The public-route boundary redirects every authenticated session away from `/login` before the public auth route can render authenticated-session recovery states such as logout-pending.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `if (session) return <Navigate to="/" replace />;` in `PublicRouteBoundary`, while `web/src/app/routes/app-routes.test.tsx` adds a test that calls `renderRoute('/login', 'authenticated', SESSION)` with `aso:logout-pending:v1` set and expects `Server sign-out pending` to render without mounting the private runtime.
findings.suggested_fix: Let `PublicAuthRoute` handle authenticated-but-blocked startup states before redirecting, or make the boundary consult the same access/logout-pending state instead of redirecting solely on `useSession()`.
